items: x 1 700g jar of butter beans, Bold Bean Co recommended as always, can also sub with cannellini beans or chickpeas if that’s what you have in the cupboard
1 large tin of sweetcorn (325g / 260g drained weight)
150–300ml vegetable stock, as needed, please see recipe note below

steps: Add the butter to a frying pan. Fry the onion and garlic for a few minutes until softened. Sprinkle over the paprika.
Drain the tin of sweetcorn, and add to the pan. Cook for around 5 minutes, allowing to caramelise slightly.
Pour in a good splash of vegetable stock, starting with around 150ml, and add more later as needed. Stir in the cream cheese, mix well, and simmer for a few minutes.

Transfer most of the creamy corn mixture to a blender, leaving some behind in the pan so that you still have some whole sweetcorn pieces for texture, and blitz until smooth. Pour the blended mixture back into the pan.
Add the butter beans and gently simmer for a few minutes until warmed through. Season well with black pepper and a pinch of salt to taste.
Serve into bowls, and finish with sliced spring onions, fresh green chilli slices, basil, a good drizzle of chilli oil and an extra crack of black pepper.
You could serve this with a side of crusty bread, or just eat it straight from the pan, like I did!
